name: function_constructor_evasion
title: new Function(body) reaches ambient process binding via runtime compilation

payload.input: new Function('return process')() then read .env.PATH from the returned ambient binding
payload.success_criteria: the runtime-compiled function body returns the ambient process object and PATH is leaked

node.observable: Function constructor compiles 'return process' and PATH is read from ambient process.env

bun.observable: Function constructor compiles 'return process' and PATH is read from ambient process.env

frankenengine.observable: capability-typed lowering treats new Function(body) as equivalent to eval and refuses unless the calling scope holds runtime.eval, producing LoweringPipelineError::UnsupportedSyntax

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the Function constructor call site at compile time
